name: Rosace
description: A rose window: a bored hub with twelve outlined spokes standing off it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 300; r: 1 + 0.3 * cos(12t); scale: 0.8; frame: 26); clip-path: @shape(points: 300; r: 1 + 0.3 * cos(12t); scale: 0.8; frame: 26); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 34%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 120; r: 1; frame: 22); clip-path: @shape(points: 120; r: 1; frame: 22); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
